sentences.10.4 Innflyttingsfest hos Marek og Ewa: 10.4 Housewarming party at Marek and Ewa's
sentences.Marek og Ewa har invitert den gamle klas: Marek and Ewa have invited Marek's old class to a housewarming party in the new apartment.
sentences.Hawa, Viola, Sompit, Biniam og Yousef ha: Hawa, Viola, Sompit, Biniam and Yousef have bought a big green plant as a housewarming present.
sentences.Velkommen, alle sammen! Så hyggelig å se: Welcome, everyone! How nice to see you!
sentences.Takk i like måte. Her er en innflyttings: Thank you, likewise. Here's a housewarming present from us to you.
sentences.Tusen takk, alle sammen. Så fin plante!: Thank you so much, everyone. What a nice plant! Come in. You can hang your jackets here in the hall.
sentences.Ewa er i butikken og kjøper te. Hun komm: Ewa is at the shop buying tea. She'll be here soon. Where is Yousef?
He's coming a bit later, I think.
sentences.Det lukter veldig godt her. Hva skal der: It smells really good in here. What are you going to serve?
You're getting a typical Polish stew. It's called bigos.
sentences.Det ringer på døra, og Marek går og åpne: The doorbell rings, and Marek goes to open the door.
sentences.Hei, Marek! Unnskyld at jeg kommer for s: Hi, Marek! Sorry I'm late. I brought my whole family. I hope that's OK. You must meet my children and my wife!
sentences.Oi! Dere kommer alle sammen! Ja, ja … Ko: Oh! You've all come! Well, well … Come in! Nice to meet you. It's going to be crowded in here now, but it's fine.
sentences.Marek går ned til Gustav for å låne stol: Marek goes down to Gustav's to borrow chairs for the guests.
sentences.Han kommer tilbake sammen med Gustav og: He comes back with Gustav and his wife.
They would like to join the party.
sentences.Ewa kommer hjem og blir overrasket over: Ewa comes home and is surprised by all the people.
sentences.Det er helt fullt i den lille leilighete: Their little apartment is completely full, but everyone is having a good time and chatting.
sentences.Noen sitter på myke puter på gulvet, og: Some people are sitting on soft cushions on the floor, and Gustav has brought some extra chairs.
sentences.Ewa og Marek serverer deilig mat og god: Ewa and Marek serve delicious food and good drinks, and after the meal they dance to Polish music.
sentences.I Norge døper vi barn i kirken, eller vi: In Norway we baptise children in church, or we have a naming party for the child.
sentences.Det gjør vi vanligvis før barnet er ett: We usually do that before the child is one year old.
sentences.Noen gifter seg i kirken, og andre gifte: Some people get married in church, and others have a civil wedding at a courthouse.
sentences.Etter 2009 kan homofile gifte seg i Norg: Since 2009 gay people have been able to marry in Norway, and since 2017 they can also marry in a church.
sentences.Seremonien kan være i kirken eller i et: The ceremony can be in church or in a public venue.
sentences.Etter seremonien er det fest med familie: After the ceremony there is a party with family and friends, and the person being confirmed often gets lots of presents.
sentences.Døde personer blir begravet eller kremer: People who have died are buried or cremated.
sentences.Det er vanlig med en seremoni i kirken e: It is common to have a ceremony in a church or a ceremony hall first, and afterwards there may be a memorial gathering with family and friends.
sentences.Vi sier «kondolerer» til den dødes famil: We say "my condolences" to the family of the person who has died.
